svg.title: halobiron/dom-to-pptx
svg.desc: dom-to-pptx: A client-side library that converts any HTML element into a fully editable PowerPoint slide. **dom-to-pptx** transforms DOM structures into pixel-accurate `.pptx` content, preserving gradients, shadows, rounded images, and responsive layouts.. 9 stars, 1 forks, JavaScript.
